attributes.description: The day the weeks of the calendar start with (or 0 to 6).

attributes.name: Format
attributes.description: How the date is written: YYYY, MM, M, DD, D, MMMM, MMM, dddd, ddd; default YYYY-MM-DD.

attributes.name: OnChanged
attributes.description: Action fired when the user chooses a date.

tags.name: TimePicker
tags.description: A time of the day: hours, minutes, optionally seconds.

attributes.name: Time
attributes.description: The time, "HH:MM" or "HH:MM:SS".

attributes.name: ShowSeconds
attributes.description: Shows the seconds.

attributes.name: MinuteStep
attributes.description: Step of the minutes for the arrows and the wheel.

attributes.name: OnChanged
attributes.description: Action fired when the user changes the time.

tags.name: Toast
tags.description: A short message that rises over the content for a few seconds (in an Overlay).

attributes.name: Text
attributes.description: A message shown when the window opens.

attributes.name: Duration
attributes.description: Seconds a message written here stays; 0: until hidden.

attributes.name: Kind
attributes.description: The color of the dot before the message.

attributes.name: ActionText
attributes.description: A button at the end of the message ("Undo").

attributes.name: OnClicked
attributes.description: Action fired by the button of the message.

attributes.name: Queue
attributes.description: A message that comes while another is shown: takes its place, waits its turn, or stacks up.

attributes.name: MaxVisible
attributes.description: How many messages a Stack shows at once (default 3).

tags.name: Breadcrumb
tags.description: The path to the current place: links separated by chevrons.

attributes.name: Items
attributes.description: The items, separated by '|' (or Item elements); the last one is the current place.

attributes.name: OnClicked
attributes.description: Action fired when the user clicks an item.

tags.name: Rating
tags.description: A score shown and chosen with stars.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.description: The score, from 0 to Max.

attributes.name: Max
attributes.description: Number of stars.

attributes.name: AllowHalf
attributes.description: Half stars can be chosen.

attributes.name: ReadOnly
attributes.description: Shown only.

attributes.name: StarSize
attributes.description: Size of a star.

attributes.name: OnChanged
attributes.description: Action fired when the user changes the score.

tags.name: Pagination
tags.description: Page numbers with previous and next.

attributes.name: PageCount
attributes.description: Number of pages.

attributes.name: Page
attributes.description: The current page, from 0.

attributes.name: Siblings
attributes.description: Page numbers shown on each side of the current one.

attributes.name: OnChanged
attributes.description: Action fired when the user goes to another page.

tags.name: PdfView
tags.description: The pages of a PDF document, scrolled and zoomed (drawn by PDFium, loaded at run time).

attributes.name: Source
attributes.description: The PDF file shown.

attributes.name: Password
attributes.description: The password of the document, when it has one.

attributes.name: Fit
attributes.description: How the pages are sized: the widest fills the width, the largest fits whole, or the Zoom.

attributes.name: Zoom
attributes.description: A zoom of its own (1: the printed size); the fit becomes None.

attributes.name: Page
attributes.description: The page shown at the top, counted from 1.

attributes.name: OnChanged
attributes.description: Action fired when the current page changes as the user scrolls.

tags.name: Plot
tags.description: Curves of X / Y data: Series elements (Name, Color, Line, LineWidth, Marker, MarkerSize, MarkerFilled, Step, Fill, XAxis, Axis, MaxPoints, X and Y lists or Points "x,y x,y"), Scatter elements, and DragLine elements (Axis, Value, Label, Color).

attributes.name: Title
attributes.description: The title over the data.

attributes.name: Legend
attributes.description: Where the legend is.

attributes.name: Crosshair
attributes.description: Lines across the data through the pointer.

attributes.name: MouseText
attributes.description: The coordinates of the pointer in a corner of the data.

attributes.name: Tooltips
attributes.description: The values of the point under the pointer, next to it.

attributes.name: Grid
attributes.description: Lines at the ticks of X and Y.

attributes.name: XLabel
attributes.description: The name of the horizontal axis (YLabel, X2Label, Y2Label for the others).

attributes.name: XScale
attributes.description: How X spreads its values (YScale, X2Scale, Y2Scale).

attributes.name: XMin
attributes.description: The lowest X shown (YMin, X2Min, Y2Min); the axis then stops following the data.

attributes.name: XMax
attributes.description: The highest X shown (YMax, X2Max, Y2Max).

attributes.name: XFormat
attributes.description: A printf format for the labels of X, "%.1f s" (YFormat...).

attributes.name: XLinearThreshold
attributes.description: SymLog: X is linear from minus this to this (default 1).

attributes.name: XGrid
attributes.description: Lines at the ticks of X (YGrid, X2Grid, Y2Grid).

attributes.name: XInverted
attributes.description: X grows to the left (YInverted: Y grows down).

attributes.name: XLocked
attributes.description: The user cannot move or zoom X (YLocked...).

attributes.name: XVisible
attributes.description: Shows or hides X (Y2Visible shows the right axis without a series on it).

attributes.name: YLabel
attributes.description: The name of the vertical axis on the left.

attributes.name: YScale
attributes.description: How Y spreads its values.

attributes.name: Y2Label
attributes.description: The name of the vertical axis on the right.

attributes.name: Y2Scale
attributes.description: How the right axis spreads its values.

attributes.name: OnChanged
attributes.description: Action fired while the user drags a drag line.

tags.name: NodeGraph
tags.description: Nodes linked by wires: Node elements (Input, Output, any widget), Link and Type elements.

attributes.name: Zoom
attributes.description: Size of the canvas: 1 = life size.

attributes.name: CenterX
attributes.description: What the middle of the widget shows, across the canvas.

attributes.name: CenterY
attributes.description: What the middle of the widget shows, down the canvas.

attributes.name: Grid
attributes.description: The dots of the canvas.

attributes.name: Flow
attributes.description: The pulses that run along the links: while the pointer is over the graph, always, or never.

attributes.name: ReadOnly
attributes.description: The user can look, select and move the view, but not change the graph.

attributes.name: FrameAll
attributes.description: Starts with every node in view.

attributes.name: OnChanged
attributes.description: Action fired when the user links, unlinks, moves or removes something.

attributes.name: Preset
attributes.description: The look it starts from; Auto follows the theme of the window. Any part can then be changed: Link.Glow="1", Node.CornerRadius="4", Header.Gradient="#000"...

attributes.name: LinkShape
attributes.description: The form of the links (also LinkShape on a Type).

attributes.name: LinkWidth
attributes.description: Thickness of the links.

attributes.name: LinkGlow
attributes.description: Light around the links, 0..1.

attributes.name: PinShape
attributes.description: The form of the pins (also Shape on a Type, an Input, an Output).

attributes.name: PinSize
attributes.description: Half the size of the pins.

attributes.name: GridStyle
attributes.description: The grid of the canvas.

attributes.name: GridSize
attributes.description: Space between the points of the grid.

attributes.name: NodeRadius
attributes.description: Corners of the nodes.

attributes.name: HeaderStyle
attributes.description: How the headers wear the color of their node (also on a Node).

attributes.name: HeaderHeight
attributes.description: Height of the headers of the nodes.
